name: Maron
source: A mermaid maid that works at the mermaid made café "Pastel Mermaid". She longs to earn money and embark on becoming a pirate. Unlike the other mermaid maids, she serves customers in pirate maid costumes. She has a bright and positive personality. However, she is clumsy because she is not used to bipedalism yet. Her popularity in the ship is very high and she is ranked number 1 by the customers. Despite this, she has the record of plates broken in a single day by a mermaid maid.
